title: Mold Remediation Final Invoice, Due Date and Job Closing
content:
The job must be in cleared status when the final invoice is issued. The final invoice amount is the total of every charge line on the job at invoicing, including any minimum charge line, and the payment due date is the invoice date plus the self-pay or insurance payment terms by funding source, counted in calendar days. The job closes when its balance due is exactly zero after invoicing; a company warranty job is invoiced at 0.00 and closes on its invoice date.

**Invoice amount.** Every charge line on the Mold Remediation job at the moment of invoicing is totalled; a minimum charge line booked at invoicing is part of that total.

**Due date.** Add the tier's payment terms for the job's funding source, in calendar days, to the invoice date: the self-pay terms for a self-pay job, the insurance terms for an insurance claim job.

**Closing.** A balance due of exactly 0.00 after invoicing closes the job. A balance above or below zero does not.

**Status evidence.** The job's status on the company's records must read cleared when the invoice is issued.

| Hypothetical job | Invoice date | Terms | Due date |
|---|---|---|---|
| Self-pay | 2 June | 15 calendar days | 17 June |
| Insurance claim | 2 June | 45 calendar days | 17 July |
| Company warranty | 2 June | Invoiced at 0.00 | Closes on 2 June |
